Alkalosis

Elevated blood [रक्त] pH is the hallmark of alkalemia, also known as metabolic alkalosis, which is often driven on by excessive acid loss, increased absorption of alkali, or a carbon dioxide deficiency.

Etiology [रोगकारण]

Metabolic alkalosis commonly arises from condition like abomasal atony, which may occur due to abomasal impaction. Under these events, potassium [पालाश] and hydrochloric acid are continuously secreted into the abomasum, resulting in hyperchloremic and hypokalaemia alkalosis. Furthermore, metabolic alkalosis can cause a shift in potassium [पालाश] from extracellular to intracellular locations, which may exacerbate hypokalaemia even in cases where the body potassium [पालाश] levels are acceptable.

Clinical signs

Animal alkalosis may be challenging to diagnose due to a lack of specific clinical symptoms [लक्षणे]. It frequently causes convulsions, tetany, tremors in the muscles, and shallow respirations. In more severe phases, dyspnoea and hyperpnea can appear.

In drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, good market prices are obtained for vegetable crops and farmers get good benefits as vegetable cultivation is very limited due to adverse climate [हवामान] (high temperature [तापमान] and dry [कोरडे] hot air) and water scarcity [पाण्याची कमतरता]. For this, it is important to select the right vegetable crop [पीक] and get quality production [उत्पादन] from it. It is difficult to grow vegetable crops in drought [दुष्काळ] conditions, but some measures can be taken to use less water [पाणी], e.g. to cultivate some vegetables by using drip and sprinkler irrigation [तुषार सिंचन]. 1. Selecting vegetable crops that require less water [पाणी] e.g. drumstick, hadga, guar and leafy vegetables.
2. Use of soil [माती] cover.
3. Onion [कांदा] Nursery [रोपवाटिका] Management [व्यवस्थापन].

- Do not use too much chemical fertilizer [रासायनिक खत] on raised beds [उंच केलेले वाफे].
- Water [पाणी] the nursery [रोपवाटिका] before sowing [पेरणी] the seeds and sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds.
- Sow [मादी डुक्कर] the seeds thinly and then use a sprinkler [तुषार सिंचन] or rain gun.
- Use shed [निवारा] net on the nursery [रोपवाटिका] if possible.

1. To protect against dry [कोरडे] and hot winds, drumstick crop [पीक] or dense planting of maize [मका] should be done on all four sides of the field [शेत] or around the wind [वारा].

3.9.1 Drip Irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]

The scientific principles of drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] are as follows:

- (i) Water Use Efficiency [जल वापर कार्यक्षमता]: Drip irrigation systems [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली] (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.10) can achieve water [पाणी]-use efficiencies exceeding 90%, compared to 4050% in traditional flood irrigation [मोकाट सिंचन / पूर सिंचन / पटपाणी] methods.<sup>15</sup>
- (ii) Soil Health [मृदा आरोग्य]: By delivering water [पाणी] directly to the root zone [मुळांचा भाग], drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] minimizes soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] and preserves soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना], promoting healthier root development [मुळांची वाढ].
- (iii) Nutrient Management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन]: The integration of fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] allows for precise application [वापर/फवारणी] of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे], enhancing nutrient uptake [अन्नद्रव्य सेवन] and reducing leaching [झिरपण प्रक्रिया] losses.

Nodal Department
PDMC focuses on enhancing water use efficiency [जल वापर कार्यक्षमता] at farm [शेत] level and thereby enhancing agricultural production [उत्पादन] & productivity. Therefore, State Agriculture [शेती]/Horticulture [उद्यानविद्या] Department may be the Nodal Department for implementation of Per Drop More Crop [पीक] scheme [योजना]. However, States are free to identify the nodal Department based on the established institutional set up and mandate of the Department. All communication between Department of Agriculture [शेती] & Farmers Welfare, GoI and State Government would be preferably with and through the Nodal Department.
 District [जिल्हा] and State Irrigation [सिंचन] Plans (DIPs & SIPs)

2. DIPs present holistic irrigation [सिंचन] development perspective of the district [जिल्हा] outlining medium to long term development plans integrating three components viz. water [पाणी] sources, distribution network and water [पाणी] use applications.
3. The annual action plans for Per Drop More Crop [पीक] will be drawn from DIPs and implemented in conjunction with the water [पाणी] sources created under convergence with other State/Central schemes.
 Objectives of Per Drop More Crop [पीक]
The main objectives of Per Drop More Crop [पीक] are as under:
- - 1. Increase the area under Micro Irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] technologies in agriculture [शेती] to enhance water use efficiency [जल वापर कार्यक्षमता].
2. Increase productivity of crops and income of farmers through precision water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन].
3. Promote micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] technologies in water [पाणी] intensive/consuming crops like sugarcane [ऊस], banana [केळी], cotton [कापूस], paddy etc. and give adequate focus to extend coverage of field [शेत] crops under micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] technologies.
4. Make potential use of micro irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] systems for promoting fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे].

भातातील गॅल माईड (गादमाशी) ही कीड मुख्यतः रोपांची पाने आणि शेंडे यांना नुकसान करते, आणि नियंत्रणासाठी प्रतिकारक वाण निवडणे, योग्य वेळी पुनर्लागवड करणे, व काही ठराविक उपाय करणे हे महत्त्वाचे आहे.

**ओळख:**
- गॅल माईडचा प्रादुर्भाव झालेल्या भाताच्या रोपांमध्ये सुरुवातीला चांदण्यासारखा (सिल्व्हर) शेंडा दिसतो; अशा शेंड्यांचा टक्का वाढल्यावर कीड अधिक पसरते.
- किडीने ग्रस्त असलेली रोपे रोपवाटिकेतून काढून नष्ट केली पाहिजेत.

**प्रतिबंध:**
- गादमाशीसाठी प्रतिकारक वाण लावा, जसे सिंदेवाही २००१, साकोली ८, पी.के.व्ही. गणेश.
- ज्या भागात गादमाशीची समस्या जास्त असते तिथे शिफारस केलेल्या तारखेपेक्षा सुमारे १५ दिवस लवकर पुनर्लागवड करा (साधारण २ ते २० जुलै दरम्यान).
- शेताच्या आजूबाजूची मदतवीज vegetative (देोधन) नष्ट करा.
- चिखलणीच्या वेळी गरडी पाने १.५० टन प्रति हेक्टर शेतात टाका; यामुळे तुडतुडे व खोडकिड्याचेही प्रमाण कमी होते.

**रासायनिक नियंत्रण:**
- रोपवाटिकेत ५% चांदण्यासारखा शेंडा आढळताच, व पुनर्लागवडीनंतर १० व ३० दिवसांनी, रेषेत ७ ते १० से.मी. पाणी असताना कार्बोफ्युरान ३% धान्यरूप २५ कि.ग्रा प्रति हेक्टर किंवा क्विनॉल्फॉस ५% धान्यरूप ५ कि.ग्रा प्रति हेक्टर टाका.
- यावेळी रेषेतले पाणी चार दिवस बाहेर काढू नये.
